evidence.evidence_text: In this paper, we propose Alignment-Enhanced Decoding (AED), a novel defense that employs adaptive decoding to address the root causes of jailbreak issues.
We first define the Competitive Index to quantify alignment failures and utilize feedback from self-evaluation to compute post-alignment logits.

Then, AED adaptively combines Competitive Index and post-alignment logits with the original logits to obtain harmless and helpful distributions.
We conduct experiments across five models and four common jailbreaks, with the results validating the effectiveness of our approach.
